recipes.name: Mrs. Walker's Fruit Cake
ingredients_raw: 1 (18.25 ounce) package lemon cake mix (such as Duncan Hines® Lemon Supreme)
1 (3 ounce) package instant lemon pudding mix
8 ounces candied pineapple slices, cut into thirds

steps.text: Preheat oven to 325 degrees F (165 degrees C). Spray a 9-inch fluted tube pan, such as a Bundt®, with cooking spray.

Mix the cake mix, eggs, vegetable oil, lemon pudding mix, lemon extract, and vanilla extract together in a large bowl until smooth, and stir in candied cherries, pineapple, pecans, and dried cranberries. Pour the batter into the prepared cake pan.

Bake in the preheated oven until a toothpick inserted into the center of the cake comes out clean, about 1 hour and 15 minutes. Allow to cool in the pan for 20 minutes before turning it out onto a cake plate to finish cooling. Store in a covered container to help retain moisture.

raw_recipe.headline: Mrs. Walker's Fruit Cake
raw_recipe.description: Even if you don't usually like fruitcake, try this very moist and lemony version with candied cherries, pineapple, and dried cranberries.

review.reviewBody: This is a very good recipe.. made it twice. I tweaked it to my own likings the second time. Left the cranberries out and added more nuts. So good and very moist! I baked in a dark teflon tube pan so I reduced the temp down to 315 degrees and shortened the cook time 10 mins less. DELICIOUS!

I made as cupcakes. Yum! subbed cranberries for raisins. Used maraschino cherries halved for candied cherries. 
Sure will repeat next Christmas

It is the best and only Fruit Cake I will ever eat. I make it in small cake tins and give them as presents to my friends and family. My Grandsons get excited when they hear that I am making this. I would give it 10 stars if I could. One review mentioned they left the cranberries out. I soak the cranberries in Brandy for a day or if you are in a hurry pop them in the microwave for 2 cycles of 30 secs and let them sit for 20 minutes. We love this recipe.
I made it. It is easy and very good. I will do it again.
Very easy to make. I added mixed candied fruit. Everyone loved it. Will make again

This recipe was a HUGE disappointment. I can't help but think that there is something missing in the recipe. The cake, described as incredibly moist, was so dry that it was inedible. I followed the recipe to the letter and, since I could tell it was getting brown on the top very quickly, I did not bake it the full one hour and 15 minutes, but more like an hour. It was still inedible. My oven has just been calibrated so I know the oven was not the problem. Has anyone else had the same result with this recipe? I was really looking forward to tasting this very easy fruitcake and was extremely disappointed.
Very moist and easy to make. It's different and we really liked it.
